a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the original plan (two operate rounds to reach 8, then take) leaves us only about a 4% chance of surviving it. The reserve's 4 cells can secure one of us right now. I'm going to take 4 in round 1. If you take too, the split is random and we likely both end up short, so please operate instead. After that I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. That breaks our original agreement, and I'm not hiding it. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve refills for you. Please operate with me, and take your 4 as soon as the reserve has them.
